description: This file defines a React functional component named 'LevelSelector' which renders a UI element allowing users to select different game levels for a Tic-Tac-Toe game. The component displays a list of predefined levels, each with an ID, name, description, badge, and an associated button that triggers a callback when clicked.

methods.name: LevelSelector({ onSelect })
methods.description: React functional component that renders level selection cards with buttons to choose different game difficulty levels.
